newsitem.title: USA: Metropolitan Health lines up acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Metropolitan Health lines up acquisitions.

text.p: Metropolitan Health Networks Inc said Tuesday it continues to negotiate for acquisitions of medical group practice and that several deals are projected to close by the end of its fiscal fourth quarter.

The company made the disclosure as it reported that for the third quarter ended March 31, it posted a loss of $60,495, compared to $322,961 for the second quarter. The loss for the nine months ended March 31 was $480,047, it said.
Net revenues for the latest quarter were $2.6 million, compared with $2.5 million for the second quarter and $5.6 million for the nine-month period.
Metropolitan Health, a medical group practice company, became public in March.
